requirement: Invalid fixture is not scored as a collector defect

files.note: Deliberately invalid GDScript: an incomplete expression (`return 1 +` with nothing after the operator), a real engine-level syntax error.

inputs.name: default
inputs.call: check.py -> real gd-tools test --coverage against an unparseable subject.gd (gd-tools-cli 0.4.0 + GUT v9.7.1)

measured_with_gd_tools_0_4_0.gd_tools_diagnostic: Warning: Skipping '.../subject/subject.gd' — syntax error prevents coverage parsing.
measured_with_gd_tools_0_4_0.engine_diagnostic: SCRIPT ERROR: Parse Error: Expected expression after "+" operator. ... Failed to load script "res://subject/subject.gd" with error "Parse error".
measured_with_gd_tools_0_4_0.gut_result: 0/1 passed, 1 error (the test itself fails because it can't call a function on a script that never loaded)
measured_with_gd_tools_0_4_0.finding: gd-tools correctly and explicitly excludes the broken file from its coverage plan with a named reason ('syntax error prevents coverage parsing'), rather than crashing, hanging, or silently including it as zero-coverage. The underlying GDScript engine's own parse error is preserved verbatim in the output, so the failure is clearly attributable to the fixture's own invalid syntax, not to gd-tools' instrumentation. The overall process exits nonzero (1), correctly signaling failure at the process level too.

notes: A clean pass for gd-tools 0.4.0/GUT 9.7.1: this is exactly the failure mode the requirement asks to distinguish from a collector defect, and both the coverage-plan layer (explicit skip with reason) and the test-runner layer (real GDScript parse error surfaced, nonzero exit) handle it correctly and legibly. Contrast with F008 (a different real defect: gdtoolkit's OWN parser -- distinct from the game engine's parser -- rejects a legitimate, valid-to-Godot file and silently drops it with no diagnostic at all) -- F061's file is genuinely invalid to the ENGINE itself, and the response here is honest, unlike F008's silent drop of a file the engine itself considers valid.
